problems.title: A parameter square has two signed roots
problems.question: Solve $x^2-p^2+6p=9$ for x.
problems.idea: Move the p-terms and complete a square.
steps: The solution set is x=p-3 or x=3-p.
When p=3 these coincide at zero.

problems.title: A cancelled factor still leaves a hole
problems.question: Find the greatest value of $(\sqrt x-2)/(x-4)$.
problems.idea: Cancel only on the original domain x≥0,x≠4.
steps: For allowed x the expression equals 1/(√x+2).
Since √x≥0, the denominator is at least 2.
The greatest value is 1/2, attained at x=0. The excluded x=4 does not affect this maximum.

problems.title: A second leg from a sum and difference
problems.question: A right triangle’s hypotenuse and one leg have difference m and sum n. Find the other leg.
problems.idea: Factor their squared difference.
steps: The givens are c-a=m and c+a=n.
A side length is positive, so b=√(mn), for valid triangle data.

problems.title: Common chord of two intersecting circles
problems.question: Two circles have radii 13 and 15 cm, with centres 14 cm apart. Find their common chord length.
problems.idea: The centre line perpendicularly bisects the common chord.
formulas: If the half-chord is h and its distances from the centres are x,14-x, then h²+x²=13² and h²+(14-x)²=15².

problems.title: Build a quadratic from its roots
problems.question: Write a quadratic equation with roots $\sqrt3$ and $\sqrt{12}$.
problems.idea: Use their sum and product.
formulas: For roots r,s, a monic equation is x²-(r+s)x+rs=0.

problems.title: A chord base inside a circumcircle
problems.question: An isosceles triangle is inscribed in a circle of radius 6 cm and has altitude 8 cm to its base. Find an equal side.
problems.idea: Place the apex at the top of a diameter and calculate the half-base.
steps: Put the centre at (0,0) and apex at (0,6). The base is at y=6-8=-2.
The equal side has squared length 32+8²=96.

problems.title: Two roots when the coefficients have opposite signs
problems.question: Solve ax²+c=0 given ac<0.
problems.idea: The quotient -c/a is positive.
steps: Divide by a to get x²=-c/a.
A positive square has two real roots.

problems.title: Respect the radical domain in a product equation
problems.question: Find the sum of the solutions of $(x^2-4x+1)\sqrt{1-x}=0$.
problems.idea: The square root requires x≤1; then split the zero product.
formulas: Quadratic formula; a product is zero if at least one factor is zero.
steps: The radical vanishes at x=1, which is a solution.
Only 2-√3 lies in x≤1; 2+√3 is outside the domain.

problems.title: Fourth powers from the root sum and product
problems.question: If x₁,x₂ solve $x^2+\sqrt2x-\sqrt3=0$, find $x_1^4+x_2^4$.
problems.idea: Use Vieta’s formulas without finding individual roots.

problems.title: A line tangent to a parabola
problems.question: Find x where y=x² and y=8x-16 have the same y-value.
problems.idea: Set the two expressions equal and complete the square.
steps: Thus the only x is 4; both functions then have y=16.

problems.title: A squared square root has a domain
problems.question: Simplify $(\sqrt{2-x})^2-\sqrt{x^2-6x+9}$.
problems.idea: Keep the first radical’s domain, then remove both roots correctly.
steps: The first term requires x≤2 and equals 2-x.
The second radicand is (x-3)², so that term is |x-3|.
problems.note: The original Word formula confirms that the square on the first term is outside the radical. Reading it as √(2-x²) would change the question.

problems.title: Recognize a square under a nested radical
problems.question: Simplify $\sqrt{19-6\sqrt2}$.
problems.idea: Find a binomial whose square gives the radicand.
steps: Since 3√2-1>0, the principal square root is that expression.

problems.title: Substitute an expression into a polynomial
problems.question: The roots of at²+bt+c=0 are -1,-2. Find the greatest root of a[2x/(x-1)]²+b[2x/(x-1)]+c=0.
problems.idea: The substituted quantity must equal one of the two original roots.
formulas: If P(t)=0 only at r,s, then P(g(x))=0 requires g(x)=r or s, on g’s domain.
steps: Both are allowed, and 1/2 is greater.

problems.title: Tangent-secant power with equal pieces
problems.question: A tangent from an external point has length 6. A secant segment is split into two equal parts by its nearer circle intersection. Find the full secant length.
problems.idea: Let each half of the full secant be t.
steps: The external part is t and the whole secant is 2t.

problems.title: A rhombus whose short diagonal equals a side
problems.question: A rhombus has its smaller diagonal equal to its side. Its inradius is 1.5 cm. Find its perimeter.
problems.idea: The equal diagonal forms an equilateral triangle with two sides of the rhombus.
formulas: A rhombus with acute angle 60° has area s²sin60°=2sr.
steps: The diagonal equality gives a 60° acute angle.

problems.title: Recover a right triangle from hypotenuse projections
problems.question: The shorter leg is 1 less than one hypotenuse projection and 6 greater than the other. Find the perimeter.
problems.idea: Write both projections in terms of that shorter leg.
formulas: For a right triangle, leg²=hypotenuse·its adjacent hypotenuse projection.
steps: Let the shorter leg be x>6. The projections are x+1 and x-6, so the hypotenuse is 2x-5.
The shorter leg corresponds to the smaller projection x-6: x²=(2x-5)(x-6).
This simplifies to x²-17x+30=(x-15)(x-2)=0; only x=15 satisfies x>6.
The hypotenuse is 25 and the other leg is √(25²-15²)=20. The perimeter is 60.

problems.title: A cyclic trapezoid with a diameter as a base
problems.question: A trapezoid’s smaller base is 2 cm. Its circumcentre lies on the larger base; the circumradius is 5 cm. Find the sum of its squared diagonals.
problems.idea: The larger base is a diameter and the smaller parallel chord is centred above it.
steps: Take the large-base endpoints as (-5,0),(5,0). The small-base endpoints are (-1,h),(1,h).
The circle gives h²+1=25, so h²=24.
Each diagonal has horizontal component 6, hence squared length 6²+24=60.

problems.title: Count integers between two square roots
problems.question: How many positive integers are strictly between √19 and √199?
problems.idea: Bound the square roots using consecutive integer squares.

problems.title: A zero quadratic coefficient changes the degree
problems.question: How many roots does 0·x²-x=0 have?
problems.idea: Simplify the zero term before classifying the equation.
steps: It has exactly the one solution x=0.

problems.title: Domain of a square root with an absolute value
problems.question: Find the domain of $\sqrt{4-|x-5|}$.
problems.idea: The radicand must be nonnegative.

problems.title: Product of roots from quadratic coefficients
problems.question: Find the product of the roots of $(2x+3)^2-12=0$.
problems.idea: Expand and use the product part of Vieta’s formulas.

problems.title: Two incircle contacts on a rectangle diagonal
problems.question: A 6 by 8 cm rectangle is divided by a diagonal. The incircles of the resulting triangles touch the diagonal at M,N. Find MN.
problems.idea: Find each contact’s distance from the same endpoint.
formulas: The diagonal is 10; each triangle has semiperimeter (6+8+10)/2=12; tangent length from a vertex=s-opposite side.
steps: In one triangle the diagonal contact is 12-8=4 cm from a chosen endpoint.
In the other, the contact is 12-6=6 cm from that same endpoint.

problems.title: Do not divide away a zero root
problems.question: Solve 0.5x²=-0.75x.
problems.idea: Bring every term to one side and factor x.

problems.title: Projection ratio from similar right triangles
problems.question: ABC is right-angled at C, CD is the altitude to AB, and DQ∥BC meets AC at Q. Given BC:AC=2:1, find CQ:QA.
problems.idea: Set up convenient coordinates; scale does not change the ratio.
formulas: The foot of the perpendicular from the origin to 2x+y=2 is found along the normal direction (2,1).
steps: The perpendicular from C has y=x/2. Solve to get D=(4/5,2/5).
Since DQ is parallel to vertical BC, Q=(4/5,0).

problems.title: External common tangent of touching circles
problems.question: Two externally tangent circles have radii r and 3r. Their external common tangent segment has length 6. Find the centre distance.
problems.idea: The tangent segment, radius difference and centre distance form a right triangle.
